title: A hold with no end: a refused out-of-range profile value is kept, so another writer's profile change stays unshown until the person repairs that field, with no sign on the page
evidence: Root fix R13 (triage 2026-11-25): one record-apply hold state that ends on the next profile save that settles, landed or refused (US-34 AC8, R13 PR 2: the relay's `settled` event; useProfileSave no longer skips it on a refused value). HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx US-34 AC8: height 400 left, a remote birthYear 1981 held, then the next save (fixed or refused again) shows it once and keeps the typed height. Follow-up (2026-11-27, US-34 AC13, PR 2218 held): a remote change arriving after the refused save was still held until the next edit (test failed on main: Expected 1981, Received 1980). The hold union gains a `refused` phase set by `settled` with outcome `refused`; the arrival carries the form (`clean`, `out-of-range`, `typing`, useProfileSave `profileForm`). In `refused` an out-of-range form applies at once; a valid edit, a unit switch, or an out-of-range value whose save has not settled still holds. Limit: a hold ended by a re-read rests in idle until the next save settles
